item.title: Pigeon 0.1.1
item.description:
What's New

New

  • Side-by-side response, {{variable}} hover and small fixes (#27)
  • Import and export Postman collections and environments (#22)

Fixes

  • Update electron and undici for security fixes (#29)
  • Keep {{variable}} matching fast on crafted text (#28)
  • Make text easier to read and show where the cursor is (#23)

item.title: Pigeon 0.2.0
item.description:
What's New

New

  • Mark {{variables}} in the body and flag undefined ones
  • Open a History entry by clicking it, and filter History
  • Find with Cmd+F in the editors and the response
  • Show which request is open, and rename it in place
  • Switch environment from a menu
  • Run commands from search (Cmd+K)
  • Paste a cURL command to create a request
  • Let requests inherit auth from their collection
  • Follow the system's light or dark appearance by default
  • Apply Postman globals under the active environment

Fixes

  • Ask before discarding an unsaved request
  • Keep each request's last response when switching
  • Open the Runner instead of starting a run
  • Stop undo from bringing back another request's body
  • Meet 4.5:1 text contrast in the light theme
  • Make the selected sidebar row stand out from hover
  • Explain why a large response isn't formatted
  • Make modals behave as dialogs
  • Give modals a neutral close button
  • Confirm deletes in the app, with Cancel focused
  • Undo deleting a History entry
  • Move a request with a searchable picker
  • Open requests without a body on Params, and label the tabs
  • Colour the response status by its class
  • Hide the workspace menu when Local is the only workspace
  • Close keyboard and screen-reader gaps
  • Give tints and shadows a light-theme value
  • Give the response the room a short request tab leaves
  • Put the sidebar's views in one row of icons
  • Put every font size on a six-step type scale
  • Put every corner radius on five tokens
  • Size buttons and modals by class, with one disabled look
  • Keep the Save request dialog's fields 32 px tall
  • Keep row colours at 4.5:1 on highlighted rows in light theme

Performance

  • Don't format the same response again on return
  • Skip the collection reload after the window's own save
  • Keep the request screen mounted behind other views
  • Match collections by id when the list reloads
  • Start the script worker before the first test run
  • Draw History 100 rows at a time and delete rows by id
  • Keep Runner progress fast as a run grows
  • Re-evaluate only the rows a sidebar drag concerns
  • Collapse the sidebar without animating its width
  • Load editor languages other than JSON when first shown

item.title: Pigeon 0.3.0
item.description:
What's New

New

  • Close the open request with ⌘W
  • Switch requests with ⌃Tab, ⌘[ and ⌘]
  • Keep unsaved requests as drafts
  • Keep example responses with a request
  • Chart a load test second by second
  • Add path variables (/orders/:orderId)
  • Open any result's response and request, keep the run
  • Show the request as sent and the headers added for it
  • Suggest variables after "{{"
  • Read the spec's security for docs, Generate and Try
  • Offer Revert for a saved request's edits
  • Name languages by library and add PowerShell, Java, Go
  • Send each import's files to the right door
  • Preview HTML responses as a page
  • Send any HTTP method, not only the eight in the list
  • Add bulk edit to key/value tables and split pasted lines
  • Duplicate and reorder folders, and order collections
  • Reorder, move and resize in the sidebar from the keyboard
  • Switch environment variables off without deleting them
  • Link, group and copy Postman import notes; accept drops
  • Show the environment each request was sent with
  • Show recent requests and common commands in ⌘K
  • Confirm a saved response and copy headers
  • Explain a response's status, time and size
  • Flag broken JSON bodies and add Beautify
  • List keyboard shortcuts and show them where commands are
  • Indent XML and HTML responses in Pretty mode
  • New requests inherit their collection's auth
  • Add missing import variables to the imported environment
  • Choose what the Runner runs
  • Show and switch the environment in the Runner and load test
  • Add ⌘N and a New menu for new requests
  • Undo deleted requests, folders, collections and runs
  • Show test results next to the response
  • Keep the whole body of a truncated response

Fixes

  • Keep the response toolbar on one row side by side
  • Use three button sizes everywhere
  • Give History, Runner and load test one header and one field
  • Make native dialogs and the window follow the in-app theme
  • Light up search boxes as a whole on focus
  • Say New request and Dismiss wherever the app means them
  • Name tree rows by their own text and group child rows
  • Keep schema columns aligned and mark required one way
  • Mark a spec's parse error and hold actions while editing
  • Name the spec on delete and offer Import afterwards
  • Call the collection dialog Collection settings and mark tabs
  • Stop cutting phase hints and run names in narrow windows
  • Say when Iterations or Delay is changed, and why
  • Keep an entry's name and link to its saved request
  • Give the load test's URL the full width
  • Clear a field's error once the field is fixed
  • Say a pre-request failure once and name a crashed test
  • Line up the Runner's result columns under a heading
  • Use one set of menu labels and flag duplicate names
  • Caption the bottom view icons and set Environments apart
  • Show a blank request after deleting the open one
  • Keep the current spot in the Move picker and say where it is
  • Stop the search box moving as you type or switch views
  • Fit OPTIONS and DELETE in the sidebar's method column
  • Say when a collection, folder or API Docs list is empty
  • Show image responses at a usable size, with their size
  • Put test failures first and fold the pre-request output
  • Make the title path clickable and say "New request" once
  • Say cURL can be pasted, and take -k over as a setting
  • Mark an invalid header name as it is typed
  • Widen the script editors and give both tabs one help
  • Show turned-off rows as off and hide the adding row's box
  • Give dropdowns an arrow and make the body type one click
  • Enlarge small targets and the environment switcher
  • Keep views and the URL usable when zoomed in
  • Keep Undo and the restore notice up while in use
  • Ask and report in the app's dialogs, not the browser's
  • Add landmarks and headings for screen-reader navigation
  • Name the unnamed controls and enlarge the small ones
  • Give every tab and toggle its role, state and keys
  • Keep selection and pressed states in Windows contrast themes
  • Give fields an edge of 3:1 against their surface
  • Bring tinted chips and placeholders to 4.5:1 contrast
  • Open the variable box from the keyboard and in the body
  • Explain a web page URL in the spec import
  • Say when a spec being imported is already there
  • Update the generated collection instead of adding a copy
  • Filter API docs endpoints and try one from its row
  • Show the mock server's URL with a Copy button
  • Give the Environments window room, a filter and bulk edit
  • Hide secret values in code snippets by default
  • Warn when a code snippet will not work as copied
  • Open load-test runs and read their tips from the keyboard
  • Make the load-test target menu searchable and keyboard-usable
  • Keep History's filter and place when coming back to it
  • Compare status, size and headers and fold unchanged lines
  • Filter a run's results to failures or passes
  • Count assertions, untested and stopped requests apart in runs
  • Stop the load-test bar overstating connection time
  • Make the ⌘K palette a modal dialog
  • Find requests by URL and loose words in the ⌘K palette
  • Scroll new requests into view in the sidebar
  • Make sidebar row actions full-size and add a More button
  • Line root requests up with folders in the sidebar
  • Name each kind of failed send and offer the next step
  • Count matches in find and return focus when it closes
  • Say when tests are running and keep the last results
  • Start each response with Auto and all headers
  • Keep the response status line on one line after redirects
  • Keep GraphQL variables in view and highlight the query
  • Show when a request's settings differ from the defaults
  • Put the caret in the URL field for new requests
  • Mark {{variables}} in headers, form rows and auth fields
  • Let generated requests and Try in builder follow base_url
  • Warn when a file row or binary body has no file
  • Treat a cancelled send as the user's choice, not an error
  • Keep Escape inside fields from leaving the view
  • Show {{variables}} in secret auth fields
  • Keep keyboard focus in place after common actions
  • Announce send results and show progress while sending
  • Reach and select the response body from the keyboard
  • Pick the right place in the Save request dialog
  • Open each request on its own tab
  • Wrap the request tabs in the side-by-side layout
  • Send ⌘S and ⌘Enter to the open dialog, not the request
  • Let long collection runs scroll to every result
  • Show responses during tests and even out spacing (#36)

Performance

  • Format large JSON responses without asking

item.title: Pigeon 0.4.0
item.description:
What's New

New

  • Load the open request when the Load test view opens

Fixes

  • Keep a title the app changes while its tooltip shows
  • Keep a run cleared while it is being saved
  • Keep an old spec worker's exit from failing a new parse
  • Show tooltips for every title, drawn by the app
  • Turn the chevron of closed collections and examples

Performance

  • Draw a collection's rows only near the visible part
  • Prepare an example's statements once per connection
  • Parse YAML specs in a worker thread
  • Build each mock response body once
  • Generate a collection's requests in one write
  • Keep the last four formatted responses, and format each one
  • Keep the response body mounted while another tab shows
  • Count find matches only when the term or the text changes
  • Show a response of one huge line as plain text
  • Save a finished run in short steps, not one transaction
  • Draw a run's results 200 at a time
  • List requests in their collection's index order
  • Fetch an open result's detail once, not on every batch
  • Lowercase an HTML response once while formatting it
  • Keep a run's response previews without the whole bodies
  • Free each send's request body once it has been used
  • List examples in index order
  • Read the History and draft lists from indexes
